changes: Shorten the bilingual summary and add bilingual section headings for better ClawHub preview and readability.
缩短双语简介，并补充核心章节的中英文标题，提升 ClawHub 预览与阅读体验。
Fix display name publishing guidance and clarify optional external tool and Zotero credential requirements.
修复双语展示名发布说明，并明确外部检索工具与 Zotero 凭据均为可选配置。
Initial release: structured multi-source literature search, evidence-based shortlist review, and user-confirmed Zotero import workflow.
首版：支持多源文献检索、证据化候选清单评审，以及用户确认后的 Zotero 导入流程。

externalTools.name: paper-search

externalTools.name: zotero-mcp
externalTools.purpose: Optional Zotero operations when configured by the user.

optionalEnv.purpose: Optional Zotero import only; never hardcode.

optionalEnv.purpose: Optional Zotero library type: user or group.

requirements.notes: Search and review workflows do not require credentials. Zotero import requires user-confirmed selected items and securely configured credentials.
